name: v0.4.4 — Fonts + neutral auth
releaseNotes:
• Fonts now force-load at startup so the custom Bricolage + Jakarta type renders reliably on every device (fixes the fallback to the system font).
• Sign In / Register screens are now a clean solid-white background (no green gradient) so the mascot stands out.

Tip: for best results, uninstall the old app and install this one fresh.
